title: Those Who Serve The True Guru Obtain
summary: Anger is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this and understand
lifeApplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this and understand
source.lifeApplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.turn: Keep returning to this turn: O Nanak, attuned to the Shabad, they are liberated. They love their Beloved Lord.
